About us

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About The Role:

As Director of Solutions Engineering at BVNK, you will lead and scale our Solutions Engineering function in your region, driving the technical strategy that supports our commercial growth and enterprise customer acquisition. You will oversee the technical partnership between the Solutions Engineers in your region and our commercial teams and prospective customers, ensuring that complex business and technical requirements are translated into scalable, commercially viable solutions using BVNK's products and infrastructure.

You will lead a team operating at the intersection of Sales, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Delivery, combining deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, strong commercial judgment, and executive-level customer engagement. Beyond supporting strategic opportunities directly, you will be responsible for building a high-performing Solutions Engineering organization, establishing scalable processes, and elevating the technical capabilities of our global commercial teams.

Your goal is to accelerate revenue growth, improve technical win rates, reduce friction throughout the sales cycle, and ensure BVNK consistently delivers technically sound, scalable solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Solutions Engineering team in your region, establishing clear expectations, performance standards, and professional development opportunities.
  • Own the strategic direction and operational effectiveness of the Solutions Engineering function, ensuring alignment with BVNK's commercial objectives and global growth strategy.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Account Management leadership to develop technical strategies that accelerate enterprise sales cycles, improve conversion rates, and support revenue growth.
  • Serve as the senior technical authority for BVNK's most complex, high-value, and strategically important customer opportunities, providing hands-on leadership where required.
  • Oversee technical discovery and solution architecture across the team, ensuring customer requirements, payment flows, integration dependencies, and regulatory considerations are thoroughly understood.
  • Drive the design and delivery of scalable, commercially viable solutions leveraging BVNK's APIs, payment infrastructure, stablecoin capabilities, and broader product ecosystem.
  • Establish best practices and consistent standards for technical qualification, solution design, architecture reviews, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Establish frameworks for identifying and managing technical risks, product gaps, implementation dependencies, and solution feasibility throughout the sales process.
  • Oversee technical components of complex enterprise procurement processes, including security assessments, architecture reviews, technical due diligence, and integration evaluations.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to evaluate emerging customer requirements, influence product roadmap priorities, and ensure commercial opportunities align with BVNK's technical capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Delivery leadership to establish effective implementation handoff processes, ensuring clear technical documentation, defined scope, and accountability for customer commitments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI-enabled tooling, standardized workflows, and more effective resource allocation.
  • Support the continued growth and evolution of the Solutions Engineering organization, including workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and establishing the structures required to scale effectively across regions and customer segments.

What we need from you:

  • Significant experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a related customer-facing technical discipline, including demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams.
  • Proven track record of building, scaling, or transforming Solutions Engineering functions within high-growth technology, fintech, payments, or enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Deep technical understanding of APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, distributed systems, and modern software integration architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of payments infrastructure, cross-border payment flows, banking integrations, and financial technology ecosystems; experience with stablecoins, digital assets, or blockchain-based payment infrastructure is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical strategy across complex enterprise sales opportunities, balancing customer requirements, technical feasibility, commercial objectives, and long-term scalability.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a clear understanding of how Solutions Engineering influences revenue generation, deal velocity, competitive differentiation, and customer acquisition.
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with CTOs, CIOs, senior engineering leaders, and commercial executives.
  • Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions and influence strategic decision-making across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience overseeing multiple complex enterprise opportunities simultaneously, prioritizing resources effectively and ensuring consistent technical execution across the team.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated success influencing Sales, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Delivery teams without direct reporting authority.
  • A strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to identify operational inefficiencies, implement scalable improvements, and leverage automation and AI to increase team effectiveness.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership responsibilities with hands-on technical involvement in critical customer engagements and complex solution design.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with the adaptability, ownership mentality, and entrepreneurial approach required to help scale a rapidly growing global business

We Offer:

  • A fair and competitive salary at every stage of your career.
  • Flexible working hours, with remote working at its heart.
  • A flexible approach to holidays. 
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world.
  • A culture built on passionate growth-minded people.

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

About the Role

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the financial strategy of a leading regional fintech. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will own the FP&A engine across multiple markets, products, and entities, with your analyses directly informing strategic decisions across new products, partnerships, and markets. This is not a reporting-coordination role: on the processes you own, your judgment is the deliverable. We are looking for someone who forms a view and puts their name on it, challenges the business when the numbers don't support the story, and is hungry to build rather than maintain. 

What You Will Do

  • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Own budgeting, forecasting, and monthly and weekly reporting cycles - delivered decision-ready and owning the recommendation
  • Management & Board Reporting: Prepare board and management materials, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives on company performance
  • Business Partnering: Work with product and commercial leaders to challenge business logic, optimize unit economics, and drive accountability for growth targets. Surface variances and deliver actionable insights independently
  • Fundraising & Investor Relations: Support capital-raising efforts by leading data room preparation — assembling, analysing, and quality-checking the financial models, performance data, and supporting materials that underpin investor due diligence.
  • Process & Systems Enhancement: Partner with accounting, commercial, and data teams to proactively identify inefficiencies in finance systems and processes, applying automation and AI to sharpen analytics and strengthen reporting accuracy. 

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or professional certification (CFA, CPA) preferred
  • 8–10+ years of experience in investment banking, strategic finance, or corporate FP&A, ideally in a high-growth or tech-driven environment
  • Advanced financial modelling, with the ability to turn complex data into a recommendation, not just an output
  • Strong communication and storytelling, with the presence to influence senior stakeholders and hold a view in front of them 
  • Deep curiosity and understanding of fintech business models, unit economics, and market trends
  • Strategic, ownership-driven mindset — able to operate autonomously and lead cross-functional initiatives from concept to execution
  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or high-growth technology companies is a strong plus
descriptions.job-058bqnh:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Supply Chain Engineer supports Hut 8’s growing infrastructure portfolio by owning and executing key elements of the procure-to-pay (P2P) lifecycle, delivery assurance, and logistics coordination.

This role ensures that purchase orders are accurately issued, partners close with suppliers to ensure delivery, materials are delivered on time and in compliance with project requirements, and payment processes remain aligned with contractual milestones.

The Supply Chain Engineer works cross-functionally with Engineering, Construction, Finance/AP, Legal, and Operations to improve order accuracy, payment flow, logistics visibility, and material availability while minimizing execution risk across capital projects.

Some of the responsibilities you can expect include the following:

Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Execution & Controls

  • Own and support the full procure-to-pay lifecycle from purchase request intake through invoice reconciliation and closeout
  • Serve as a central coordination point between Engineering, Construction, suppliers, Finance/AP, and Legal
  • Validate scope, pricing, specifications, delivery terms, tax treatment, and approvals prior to PO issuance
  • Issue and track purchase orders in ERP systems in alignment with internal controls and approval workflows
  • Monitor payment milestones and ensure alignment between PO terms, delivery status, and invoice submissions
  • Maintain clean and auditable purchasing records

Logistics & Delivery Coordination

  • Proactively expedite suppliers to confirm production schedules, manufacturing progress, and committed ship dates
  • Track long-lead and critical-path equipment to ensure alignment with project schedules
  • Identify early risk indicators including capacity constraints, sub-supplier delays, inspection issues, or logistics bottlenecks
  • Escalate schedule deviations and coordinate corrective actions
  • Maintain detailed delivery trackers with real-time visibility into production, shipment, and site receipt status

Process Improvement & Controls

  • Develop and maintain standardized P2P workflows and expediting procedures
  • Create and improve templates, trackers, dashboards, and logistics reporting tools
  • Identify process bottlenecks in purchasing, delivery, or payment flow
  • Recommend improvements to reduce risk, increase visibility, and improve cash flow timing

ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field preferred (equivalent experience considered)
  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain operations, procure-to-pay, logistics coordination, or project-based supply chain environments
  • Mandarin (Native or Fluent)
  • Demonstrated experience managing purchase orders, expediting suppliers, and coordinating deliveries
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple high-value orders simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving infrastructure or industrial environment
  • Preferred: Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Odoo)

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially minded Tax, Partner to lead tax planning, structuring, and execution across a capital-intensive, infrastructure-driven business. This role will be responsible for developing and implementing tax strategies that support long-term growth, optimize cash taxes, and align with the Company’s operating model, investment strategy, and transaction activity.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical tax expertise, strong business judgment, and experience advising on complex matters involving data centers, cost segregation, capital expenditures, M&A, managed services, cloud and colocation arrangements, and tax-efficient structuring.

This is a highly visible role that will partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Operations, Corporate Development, Treasury, and external advisors.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Tax Planning

  • Lead the development and execution of tax strategies that support the Company’s business objectives, growth plans, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to optimize cash taxes, effective tax rate, tax attributes, and entity structure.
  • Advise leadership on tax implications of major business decisions, including capital investments, financing structures, commercial arrangements, and expansion into new jurisdictions.

Capital Expenditures, Data Centers & Cost Segregation

  • Drive tax planning for capital-intensive projects, including data center development, infrastructure buildouts, equipment purchases, leasehold improvements, and related investments.
  • Lead cost segregation studies and depreciation planning to maximize tax efficiency and cash tax benefits.
  • Partner with Operations, Legal, Corporate Development, Accounting, and external advisors to ensure capital projects are structured, documented, and classified appropriately for tax purposes.
  • Evaluate tax strategies related to bonus depreciation, tangible property regulations, repairs versus capitalization, and asset classification.

M&A & Transactions

  • Support tax diligence, structuring, modeling, and integration for acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, carve-outs, and other strategic transactions.
  • Advise on tax-efficient deal structures, purchase price allocations, tax attributes, indemnities, transaction costs, and post-close integration matters.
  • Partner with Corporate Development, Legal, and external advisors to assess transaction risks and opportunities.

Managed Services & Commercial Arrangements

  • Advise on tax considerations related to managed services agreements, hosting arrangements, intercompany services, revenue models, and customer or vendor contracts.
  • Assess tax implications of operating models, including transfer pricing, revenue sourcing, sales and use tax, property tax, withholding tax, and indirect tax considerations.
  • Help ensure commercial agreements are structured in a tax-efficient and operationally practical manner.

Tax Compliance, Reporting & Governance

  • Oversee federal, state, local, and applicable international tax compliance processes.
  • Partner with Accounting on tax provision, deferred taxes, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Develop scalable tax processes, controls, documentation, and governance frameworks.
  • Manage relationships with external tax advisors and ensure high-quality, cost-effective support.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on tax matters.
  • Translate complex tax concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Build strong working relationships across Finance, Legal, Operations, Corporate Development, and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor and develop tax team members as the function grows.

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, or related field required; CPA, JD, or Master’s in Tax preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive tax experience, including public accounting and/or corporate tax experience.
  • Strong experience with strategic tax planning, corporate tax structuring, and tax compliance.
  • Experience with capital-intensive businesses, infrastructure, energy, real estate, data centers, or similar asset-heavy industries strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with cost segregation, depreciation planning, capitalization rules, and fixed asset tax strategies.
  • Experience supporting M&A, divestitures, carve-outs, restructuring, and post-transaction integration.
  • Familiarity with managed services agreements, intercompany arrangements, and tax considerations for complex commercial contracts.
  • Strong understanding of federal, state, local, and indirect tax matters.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, project management, and executive-facing skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • The successful candidate will be more than a technical tax expert. They will be a strategic business partner who can connect tax planning to value creation.
  • They should be proactive, commercially aware, highly organized, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with complex transactions, large capital projects, and evolving business models.
  • They will bring intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to identify tax opportunities while appropriately managing risk.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. We create and operate the infrastructure that enables Stripe teams to localize product interfaces, services, and written communications while delivering consistent, high-quality experiences to users around the world.

We work closely with our sister Localization team and its language experts, as well as with product and service engineering teams integrating localized content. Together, we combine engineering, automation, and linguistic expertise to help Stripe build products that feel native to each market.

What you’ll do

You will design, implement, and maintain Stripe’s internationalisation platform at scale, including the developer and user experiences around it. You’ll help teams continuously localize their products while improving the quality, speed, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s localization processes.

This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology. Depending on the project, you may build end-to-end functionality for internal customers, evolve production LLM systems, develop quality-evaluation capabilities, improve platform reliability and observability, or lead migrations from legacy localization infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build internationalisation infrastructure that supports diverse content surfaces, including backend services, product interfaces, and written communications.
  • Integrate localization into Stripe’s software-development and content-production workflows, enabling teams to ship translated experiences continuously and safely.
  • Build and maintain integrations with translation-management systems, LLM services and external localization providers.
  • Evolve Stripe’s existing production LLM capabilities to improve translation quality, market relevance, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop automated quality checks and human-evaluation workflows that combine LLM-driven automation with expert linguistic judgment.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability through effective testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.
  • Own ambiguous, high-impact initiatives end to end—from research and experimentation through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic)
  • Experience developing reliable infrastructure, platform, or backend-service solutions.
  • Strong product judgment and a commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
  • Ability to own ambiguous work end to end and make progress through research, experimentation, and iteration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building or operating production LLM or machine-learning systems.
  • Experience evaluating LLM output or combining automated systems with expert human review.
  • Familiarity with internationalisation, localization, translation, or content-management workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or workflow infrastructure.
  • Backend engineering experience building services using programming languages such as Java, Ruby, or Go.
  • Experience building internal platforms that ultimately support customer-facing products.

Stripe’s SMB and Commercial Sales organization helps ambitious businesses adopt Stripe’s financial infrastructure and accelerate their growth. The team is responsible for acquiring new users, expanding Stripe’s relationships with existing users, and building durable partnerships across a diverse and fast-moving market.

We’re looking for an experienced second-line sales leader to lead our SMB and Commercial business across Southern Europe. You will manage a team of sales managers and Account Executives, set the regional strategy, and be accountable for delivering sustainable growth across multiple countries, customer segments, and sales motions.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to develop leaders. You will work closely with regional and global Sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Marketing, Partnerships, Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Deal Pricing, and Operations.

As Head of Southern Europe, SMB & Commercial, you will own the strategy, performance, and development of a complex, multi-market sales organization. You will build and lead a high-performing leadership team, translate Stripe’s broader strategy into clear regional priorities, and create the operating environment required to deliver consistent results at scale.

You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in the business. You’ll help your managers raise the performance of their teams, engage directly in the region’s most important opportunities, and represent Southern Europe in regional and global planning.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall strategy and commercial performance of Stripe’s SMB and Commercial business across Southern Europe.

  • Build a strong leadership bench by hiring exceptional managers, setting clear expectations, and creating development and succession plans.

  • Experience leading through periods of rapid growth, organizational change, or significant ambiguity.

  • Ability to influence across a highly cross-functional and matrixed organization without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions, and make informed decisions.

  • A commitment to building inclusive teams and creating a culture of high standards, continuous improvement, and shared accountability.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading SMB and Commercial sales teams with distinct coverage models, sales cycles, and customer needs.

  • Experience managing a geographically distributed organization across several Southern European markets.

  • Experience scaling a business through multiple phases of growth rather than inheriting a mature and stable organization.

  • A track record of successfully leading both new-business acquisition and existing-customer expansion motions.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, SaaS, or another technically complex industry.

  • Familiarity with platform, marketplace, subscription, or usage-based business models.

  • Experience engaging with founders, CEOs, CFOs, and other C-level decision-makers.

About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

Who are we?

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and  cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

Position Summary

FalconX is seeking a Personal Account Dealing Senior Compliance Associate to join our team and help to manage the program governing employee trading and conflicts of interest across the firm. In this role, you will review and adjudicate personal trading pre-clearance requests, monitor employee holdings and transactions for policy breaches, and administer the systems that make this program run. You will work at the intersection of compliance, data, and market structure — operating vendor-based employee compliance tooling alongside FalconX's internal systems to identify conflicts, detect undisclosed activity, and ensure the firm meets its code of ethics and market abuse obligations across the jurisdictions in which we operate.

Because FalconX operates in digital assets, this role extends the traditional personal account dealing discipline into self-custody wallets, on-chain activity, and token holdings. This role requires equal parts investigative rigor, technical comfort, and absolute discretion, and offers a unique opportunity to shape personal trading practice at one of the leading institutional digital asset platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pre-Clearance Adjudication: Independently review, approve, deny, or escalate employee pre-clearance requests for personal securities and digital asset transactions, applying restricted list rules, blackout periods, holding period requirements, and conflict checks within committed turnaround times.
  • Breach Identification & Escalation: Investigate suspected breaches of the personal account dealing policy — trading in restricted names, front-running firm or client activity, breach of minimum holding periods, use of undisclosed accounts — and prepare clear investigative narratives with supporting evidence for escalation to the Compliance Manager.
  • Restricted & Watch List Maintenance: Assist with maintaining the firm's restricted and watch lists, ensuring names and tokens are added and released on the correct triggers, and that list changes propagate correctly into the pre-clearance rule set.
  • MNPI Coordination: Work with Legal, Corporate Development, and business heads to ensure that material non-public information — deal activity, upcoming listings, client mandates — is reflected in trading restrictions on a timely basis.
  • Gifts & Entertainment / Outside Business Activities: Review and disposition gifts and entertainment and OBA submissions against firm thresholds, identify aggregation and pattern concerns, and escalate submissions raising bribery, inducement, or client-conflict risk.

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

  • Regulatory Alignment: Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the personal trading and conflicts requirements applicable to the firm's regulated entities and their equivalents across jurisdictions, together with digital-asset-specific guidance, ensuring the program's coverage remains fully compliant as the regulatory perimeter shifts.
  • Policy Contribution: Partner with the Compliance Manager to update the personal account dealing policy, code of ethics, review playbooks, and standard operating procedures as regulations, product lines, and market structures evolve — with particular focus on where existing policy language does not cleanly address digital asset activity.
  • Audit Readiness: Assemble pre-clearance records, breach files, attestation completion evidence, and decision rationale for internal audit, bank partner reviews, and regulatory examinations, ensuring each file stands on its own without verbal explanation.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Law, Data Science, or a related field.

Experience: 1–3 years of direct experience in personal account dealing, code of ethics, or employee compliance monitoring at a broker-dealer, asset manager, bank, proprietary trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform. Experience running or administering a personal trading program — not solely submitting into one — is strongly preferred.

Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with STAR Compliance is strongly preferred, including administrator-level familiarity with pre-clearance rule configuration, broker and custodian data feeds, attestation campaigns, and reporting. Analytical Mindset: Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to reconstruct what an employee actually traded from incomplete records, spot the account that was never disclosed, and distinguish a genuine oversight from a deliberate circumvention.

Discretion & Judgment: Proven ability to handle sensitive personal information about colleagues with complete confidentiality, and the composure to make and defend unpopular decisions — including denying a request from a senior stakeholder — without escalating unnecessarily or capitulating inappropriately.

Communication: Crisp verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions clearly, explain a denial in terms an employee understands, and articulate personal trading expectations to non-compliance stakeholders across the firm.

Digital Asset Interest: Genuine interest in digital asset markets and the practical mechanics of self-custody, on-chain activity, staking, and airdrops — enough to reason about how a policy written for equities should apply to a wallet.
